## NFL injury briefing

### Texans
- **QB Graham Mertz**: MRI confirmed a **torn right ACL**. He’s expected to miss a significant stretch.
- Houston also listed **Ja’Marcus Ingram (shoulder)**, **Josh Pitsenberger (ankle, a couple weeks)**, **Collin Wright (soft-tissue strain, day to day)**, **Jake Hansen (ankle)**, **Brevin Jordan (knee)**, **Jawhar Jordan (strained hip flexor)**, and **British Brooks (broken hand)**.

**Why it matters:** Houston’s QB depth gets thinner, and the Texans are juggling a long injury list across multiple position groups.  
**Watch next:** Any follow-up testing on Mertz and whether Houston adds quarterback depth.

### Jets
- **Geno Smith** was scratched from the preseason opener vs. the Buccaneers with a **sore ankle**.
- Coach Glenn said he’s **day to day** and “nothing to be alarmed about.”

**Why it matters:** Likely short-term, but it costs him reps and keeps the QB situation on watch.  
**Watch next:** Whether Smith returns to practice without restriction.

### Cardinals
- **OL Chase Bisontis** tore his **left MCL** and will have surgery next week.
- His season is **in doubt**, though a later update said he’s slated for a **full recovery**.

**Why it matters:** Arizona loses a young lineman who was expected to compete for playing time.  
**Watch next:** Rehab timeline and whether the Cardinals adjust the interior line mix.

### Falcons
- **Edge rusher Jalon Walker** is out for the **2026 season** after ACL surgery.
- **James Pearce Jr.** will miss **at least the first eight games**.

**Why it matters:** Atlanta’s pass-rush plan takes a major hit before the season starts.  
**Watch next:** How the Falcons patch the edge rotation early in the year.

### Saints
- Rookie WR **Jordyn Tyson** will **miss time** with a **right hamstring** injury, per coach Kellen Moore.

**Why it matters:** More missed camp reps for a rookie trying to climb the depth chart.  
**Watch next:** How long he sits and who absorbs the extra snaps.

### Returning from injury
- **Buccaneers OLB David Walker** is back in camp after last year’s torn ACL and has been active in practice.

**Why it matters:** Encouraging sign for Tampa Bay’s edge depth.  
**Watch next:** Whether he stays healthy and translates camp production into preseason games.
